head: 223a5f6dec14f31572c1fa5bbd20f20b3e2c5ac6
summary:
The rework answers every finding that was disposed accepted-pending, and I checked each answer against the tree. Nothing new is broken.
- M1: the tree header now promises only sizes ('Sizes marked at least may grow; unmarked sizes are final.'), and says shares, bars and order are by space on disk as listed.
- M2: that clause ends at index 101, inside the roughly 109 characters SL-110 measured as drawn at 880 px. T-013 checks headerCharsShown against the clause's end. The list headers are no longer claimed to be drawn.
- M3: AtLeastFigures becomes a standalone readonly struct with an internal constructor, so the App cannot put the word on a long. Placing it in namespace FsAnalyser.Core rather than in a Store file is justified: `using FsAnalyser.Core.Store;` in TopLevelRowText.cs would match `(?<!\bresult)\.Store\b` (fitness.yaml:476). Every existing test use survives:
  - positional `new Figures(...)` reaches the internal constructor through InternalsVisibleTo;
  - `==`, `!=` and interpolated ToString are provided;
  - no test uses `with`, deconstruction or named constructor arguments (UnfinishedTests.cs:6, 565, 660, 702, 740, 790, 793; UnfinishedBudgetTests.cs:137, 162, 228).
- m1: the validate list now carries the rules harness (Q-027), RuleCases C-001/C-003, and T-003 (Q-128).
- m3: one guard, ScanResult.MarksAtLeast, now gates both the list's read and the tree's bound reads. A completed tree never calls Unfinished.
- m4: TreeAtLeastRolled and NarrowAtLeastCells are added. WindowMutants' single (?s) Find can carry both.
- m2: deferred by decision; not re-opened.
C4's 'unmarked list rows equal storeRolled' check holds for file and link rows too, because RolledSize returns the charged size for a non-folder (ScanStore.Rollup.cs:19-24). The recalled C# claims are correct, so the remaining risk is the ancestor-propagation precondition, which is still only as strong as SL-111's conditional:
  - lookup through the enclosing namespace;
  - `with` on a non-record struct cannot set get-only members;
  - `default` and `new S()` stay available and read (0, 0, 0).

dimensions_checked.result:
none. The claims were checked:
- RolledSize is the charged size for files and 0 for links (ScanStore.Rollup.cs:15-24), so C4's unmarked-equals-storeRolled check is sound for every top-level kind.
- Unfinished checks NotListedAtOrBelow before PendingRun (ScanStore.cs:208-211); the design now states this and guards it with MarksAtLeast.
- The 109-character header figure is marked recalled, but it is SL-110's measurement for the old string. The new clause holds more wide glyphs (m, w), so the margin is about 8 characters, and T-013's headerCharsShown check turns any shortfall into a FAIL rather than a silent cut.
The must-verify precondition (ancestors marked up to the root) is unchanged. It rests on depth-first registration with one SetChildren per block, so a future pause or resume, or parallel listing, would leave an ancestor unmarked with no error in the App. Fact (e) and T-013 C2 pin today's order only; this is SL-111's standing condition, not a new gap.

none new. The header no longer covers the share column (M1 answered). A NotRead list row keeps its title mark and today's text (Q-276 open). In the marked list arm, the tracker's folder and unreadable counts are true lower bounds, because both only grow; this is recorded as taste. A Stop in the size checks is covered by Core facts plus L-004, and a window case for it is filed as a slice, as was accepted before.

none. The rolled-figure trap is now closed by a type: AtLeastSizeText and AtLeastOnDiskText take only AtLeastFigures, whose constructor is internal to Core, whose InternalsVisibleTo names only Core.Tests, and which has no `with` target. Inside Core, construction is fenced by the new rule plus review. The list and the tree share one predicate under one guard (MarksAtLeast).

none. TopLevelAtLeast is gone. Net fitness.yaml churn is two rules: the inert one is removed and a construction fence is added. Four mutants (~5-6 min) and T-014 are recorded as taste, each tied to a criterion or a measured no-go.

none. Checked:
- AtLeastFigures' members (get-only Size, OnDisk and Files, with IEquatable, == and !=) cover every existing test use. Grep found no deconstruction, `with` or named arguments in Core.Tests.
- TopLevelRow.AtLeast is init-only on a class with an internal constructor, so only Core sets it.
- WithRows keeps every snapshot field.
- MarksAtLeast is the single guard; its Count > 0 term is redundant (TopLevel non-null implies Count >= 1) but harmless.

none new. The uncontained throw at MainWindow.xaml.cs:301 was deferred by decision to the Q-071 backlog item, and the contract now says a contained failure must clear the list and never fall back to unmarked rows. Exceptions in the tree's bound reads stay inside OneTime binding getters, where they become a trace line and an empty cell.

none. M3's disposition said 'its own Store file'. The design places AtLeastFigures in src/FsAnalyser.Core with namespace FsAnalyser.Core, because `using FsAnalyser.Core.Store;` in TopLevelRowText.cs would trip `(?<!\bresult)\.Store\b` (.taad/fitness.yaml:476). That keeps the disposition's intent: the type closes the class. Q-290 is honoured: only the size clauses and the two pinned constants change, and the tree header is pinned only by StartsWith($StoppedTreeLead). Q-276 and Q-292 are not answered or pre-empted; Q-293 is followed.

none. Checked against the rules:
- AtLeastFigures in Core root names no ScanStore. 'Core does not publish a live ScanStore' only forbids the name; Store/**'s 'store does not know about the Scanner' is unaffected; and 'TheScannerCoreDoesNotKnowAboutTheScreen' is unaffected because Core imports no App or WPF.
- `public AtLeastFigures? AtLeast { get; init; }` passes all five snapshot-immutability patterns.
- The Revised assignment stays in the exempt TopLevelTracker.cs.
- SizeText and OnDiskText keep the HasFigures guard, so 'a tree row's figure text is never guarded by the store alone' stays quiet.
- MainWindow reaches the store only as result.Store or result.MarksAtLeast.
- The headers interpolate AtLeastWord with no literal and no FormatSize.
- The new 'only the store constructs a lower bound' rule excepts the two files that construct one today and does not reach tests.
- The settled rules need no xUnit twin.

none. T-013 now checks the drawn header clause and the unmarked list rows against the store, not only the strings. Each check that matters has a mutant that should turn it red: NoTreeAtLeast, NoListAtLeast, TreeAtLeastRolled and NarrowAtLeastCells. NarrowAtLeastCells needs a Find specific to the SizeText cell, because Width="102" will occur four times; WindowMutants' single (?s) Find per mutant (WindowMutants.ps1:69, 73) can carry that, and can carry TreeAtLeastRolled's two-cell edit. The validate list includes harness.py, C-001/C-003 and T-003. It names the other tree and layout cases only as 'the other cases that draw tree rows or headings'; the m1 disposition already owes T-001 and T-004 by name.
none: a display change over the app's own in-memory store, with no new file, process, network or privilege surface.
